items.exampleZh: 這些是我平常穿的衣服。

items.exampleEn: Sorry, I am in a hurry.
The interviewer asks me many questions.
items.exampleZh: 面試官會問我很多問題。

items.exampleEn: I read my email every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我每天早上看電子郵件。

items.sentenceEn: I write emails every day at work.
items.sentenceZh: 我每天在公司寫電子郵件。

items.audioEn: I am in a hurry. I will call you on my mobile.
items.audioZh: 我在趕時間，我會用手機打給你。

items.sentenceEn: Hurry up! The bus is coming.

items.stemEn: It is twelve at night, but the baby is ____.
items.stemZh: 已經半夜十二點了，寶寶還醒著。

items.stemEn: Write me an ____ when you get home.
items.stemZh: 你到家時寫封電子郵件給我。

items.passageEn: Sara is in a hurry this morning. She has an interview at nine. She is awake at six, but she can't find her mobile phone. It is under the bed! She gets to the interview at nine. The interviewer is very nice.
items.passageZh: Sara 今天早上很趕。她九點有一場面試。她六點就醒了，可是找不到手機，原來在床底下！她九點到了面試的地方。面試官人很好。

items.promptZh: 我每天早上看電子郵件。
referenceEn: I read my email every morning.
I read my emails every morning.
rubricZh: 「看電子郵件」可寫 read my email(s)、check my email 等
習慣性的事用現在簡單式；every morning 放句首或句尾都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 hurry 造一個句子，說說你很趕時間的情況。
referenceEn: I am in a hurry. I have a meeting at nine.
Sorry, I can't talk. I am in a hurry.
rubricZh: 「趕時間」可用 be in a hurry（例如 I am in a hurry）
也可用動詞 hurry（例如 I have to hurry）
